recognize_zh: 臨床照片可見雙眼鞏膜呈均勻的黃褐色，眼周皮膚色調偏黃；配合病史（重度再生不良性貧血、高劑量 eltrombopag）且肝功能正常，應考慮藥物引起的皮膚與鞏膜變色，而非真正的膽紅素性黃疸。
features: Bilateral diffuse yellow to yellow-brown discoloration of the bulbar conjunctiva/sclera
Subtle yellowish tint of periorbital and facial skin
No visible conjunctival hemorrhage, pallor-related findings, or periorbital purpura in this view
describe_en: Clinical photograph of the face shows bilateral, symmetric yellow to yellow-brown discoloration of the sclerae with a subtle yellowish tint of the surrounding skin. No subconjunctival hemorrhage or periorbital purpura is seen. The photograph alone cannot distinguish true icterus from pigment deposition; given normal liver function tests in a patient receiving high-dose eltrombopag, the findings are consistent with eltrombopag-associated skin and scleral discoloration rather than hyperbilirubinemia.

ddx.vs: True icterus is accompanied by elevated serum bilirubin, whereas eltrombopag-related discoloration occurs with normal bilirubin and liver tests.
Carotenemia yellows the palms, soles, and nasolabial skin but characteristically spares the sclerae.
Drug-induced liver injury raises transaminases and bilirubin, which were normal in this patient.

ddx.dx: Hemolysis from an expanding PNH clone in aplastic anemia
ddx.vs: PNH-related hemolysis shows elevated indirect bilirubin and LDH, low haptoglobin, and a PNH clone by flow cytometry.
